title: Listen word by word
caption: Read Aloud highlights the paragraph and the exact word being spoken, while the focus mask dims everything else.

title: Dyslexia-friendly fonts and tints
caption: Switch any page to OpenDyslexic, add spacing and a soft tint, and ClearPath remembers it for that site.

title: Click to hide distractions
caption: Target & Hide outlines what is under your mouse, and one click removes it on every visit. Undo works even after a reload.

title: One click or one shortcut
caption: Open the Zen panel from the toolbar, or press Alt+Shift+Q on any page.

title: Friendly from the first click
caption: A short welcome tip shows the basics and the keyboard shortcuts the first time you open the panel.
